Updated the existing Treasury Bulletin maturity-schedules skill and memory.

Key generalizable lesson saved:
For 1940s/early-1950s Treasury Bulletin maturity schedule questions, “fixed maturity type” means the fixed-maturity subtotal/line within the U.S. Government-issued marketable securities section, not the grand total of all marketable public securities and not guaranteed/callable categories. This exact confusion can produce the wrong projection around 57.0 instead of the correct fixed-maturity projection around 39.5.
